Additionally you can also create an allowlist of domains and mobile applications and option to serve only on those sites and mobile applications.

If you don't want LinkedIn to serve your content off network, set the offsiteDeliveryEnabled flag on your campaign to false.

By using domain block/allow lists, advertisers ensure that their ads are only served to their target audience and excluded/included from certain specific websites. Learn more about uploading a block/allow list within Campaign Manager.
Domain block/allow lists can be uploaded through the Campaign Manager UI as documented here or through the API as documented below in Creating Domain Publisher Lists.

Blocks.Section: Get a Campaign with Domain Restricted List
SectionPath: Get a Campaign with Domain Restricted List
Blocks.Text: The following example fetches a Sponsored Update campaign that has offsite serving enabled. The offsite audience excludes/includes some domains. For brevity, the campaign response has been limited to the relevant fields using projection.

Blocks.Section: Get a Campaign with Domain Restricted List
SectionPath: Get a Campaign with Domain Restricted List

Blocks.Section: Get a Campaign with Domain Restricted List
SectionPath: Get a Campaign with Domain Restricted List
Blocks.Text: A block list is named adPublisherFile in the API and is listed under publisherRestrictionFiles.

SectionPath: Get a Campaign with Domain Restricted List

Rows.Text: Allow this campaign access to be served on the LinkedIn Advertising Network

Blocks.Text:
curl -X GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/adAccounts/{adAccountId}/adCampaigns/{campaignId}?fields=offsitePreferences,offsiteDeliveryEnabled,type' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}' \
-H 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \ 
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0'

Blocks.Section: Get Publisher Restriction List File Details
SectionPath: Get Publisher Restriction List File Details
Blocks.Text: To get more details on the adPublisherFile URN in the previous sample response, make an additional request.

curl -X GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/adPublisherRestrictions/1603' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}'\
-H 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \ 
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0'
Alternatively when you fetch the campaign, you can resolve the adPublisherFile by decorating the URN.

curl -X GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/adAccounts/{adAccountId}/adCampaigns/133066184?projection=(offsitePreferences(publisherRestrictionFiles(exclude*~)),offsiteDeliveryEnabled,type)' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}'\
-H 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \ 
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0'

Blocks.Section: Get Global Publisher Allow List of Domains and Apps
SectionPath: Get Global Publisher Allow List of Domains and Apps
Blocks.Text: The following example retrieves a URL that can be utilized to perform a basic GET request and retrieve a comprehensive list of domains and apps curated by LAN for displaying ads. You can select from a predefined list of categories to specify the type of publisher list you want to download: either CONNECTED_TELEVISION or WEB_AND_APP, with the default option set to WEB_AND_APP. This list can serve as a reference to reduce the size of allowlists and blocklists created by advertisers, as it contains the superset of publishers. Publishers outside of this list will not have ads displayed to them.

SectionPath: Get Global Publisher Allow List of Domains and Apps

Rows.Text: The global publisher list category specifies the type of publisher list to be downloaded. CONNECTED_TELEVISION / WEB_AND_APP. Default to WEB_AND_APP.

SectionPath: Get Global Publisher Allow List of Domains and Apps

Rows.Text: Content type for the request, must be: application/json

SectionPath: Get Global Publisher Allow List of Domains and Apps

Rows.Text: URL to download block list content

Blocks.Text:
curl -X POST 'https://api.linkedin.com/rest/globalPublisherList' \
-H 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}' \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
-H 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \ 
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0
--data '{
  "publisherListType": "WEB_AND_APP"
}'

Blocks.Section: Get Publisher Restriction Files Details Applied at Advertiser Account
SectionPath: Get Publisher Restriction Files Details Applied at Advertiser Account
Blocks.Text: Retrieves the allowlist/blocklist applied at the ad account level. Allows you to view the current publisher restriction files configured for a specific sponsored account. The response provides include lists (allowlists) and exclude lists (blocklists) of publisher file URNs, along with audit information about when the preferences were created and last modified.

SectionPath: Get Publisher Restriction Files Details Applied at Advertiser Account
Get Publisher Restriction Files Details Applied at Advertiser Account

-H 'Authorization: Bearer {INSERT_TOKEN}' \
-H 'Linkedin-Version: {version number in the format YYYYMM}' \ 
-H 'X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0'

Blocks.Section: Apply Publisher Restriction at Ad Account Level
SectionPath: Apply Publisher Restriction at Ad Account Level
Blocks.Text: The /adAccountTrustPreferences API is used to manage account-level brand safety controls, specifically allowlists and blocklists for the LinkedIn Audience Network. This API enables you to view and update publisher restrictions (web domains/app store URLs) at the ad account level.

Blocks.Section: Apply Publisher Restriction at Ad Account Level
SectionPath: Apply Publisher Restriction at Ad Account Level

Blocks.Section: Apply Publisher Restriction at Ad Account Level
SectionPath: Apply Publisher Restriction at Ad Account Level
Blocks.Text: Create or update the allowlist/blocklist for an ad account. This endpoint performs an upsert operation, which means if trust preferences don't exist for the account, they will be created. If they already exist, they will be updated with the new values. You can specify publisher restriction files for both include lists (allowlists) and exclude lists (blocklists).

SectionPath: Apply Publisher Restriction at Ad Account Level

Rows.Text: List of publisher file URNs to allow (allowlist). Only ads on these domains/apps will be served.
